nodes.name: desktop.nix
nodes.summary: Nix derivation packaging the Tauri-based OpenCode desktop app. It inherits version, src, and node_modules from the opencode CLI derivation, builds the Rust/Tauri bundle against GTK4 and WebKitGTK on Linux, stages the CLI binary as a sidecar, and renames the output binary to opencode-desktop.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses rustPlatform.buildRustPackage with cargoRoot pointing at packages/desktop/src-tauri; the Linux postFixup renames OpenCode to opencode-desktop to dodge case-insensitive filesystem conflicts.

nodes.name: hashes.json
nodes.summary: Stores the per-platform sha256 fixed-output hashes for the opencode node_modules derivation across the four supported Linux and macOS platforms.

nodes.name: node_modules.nix
nodes.summary: Fixed-output Nix derivation that runs bun install with a frozen lockfile for the opencode, desktop, and app workspace packages, then canonicalizes symlinks and normalizes bin entries via the bundled scripts, yielding a reproducible node_modules tree keyed by the hashes in hashes.json.
nodes.languageNotes: Achieves reproducibility through outputHashMode = "recursive" content addressing; cross-platform builds are steered with bun's --cpu/--os flags instead of native interpreters.

nodes.name: opencode.nix
nodes.summary: Main Nix derivation for the opencode CLI: stages the prebuilt node_modules tree, patches shebangs, compiles the self-contained binary via script/build.ts --single under bun, installs schema.json, and wraps the binary with ripgrep and shell completions.

nodes.name: canonicalize-node-modules.ts
nodes.summary: Post-install build script that rebuilds node_modules/.bun/node_modules symlinks so every package slug resolves to its highest installed version, making bun's content-addressed store look like a canonical node_modules layout for Nix packaging.
nodes.languageNotes: Top-level-await ESM script driven by Bun APIs (Bun.semver.order/satisfies); parseEntry decodes bun's "@scope+name@version" directory labels.

nodes.name: normalize-bun-binaries.ts
nodes.summary: Post-install build script that scans bun's package store, reads each manifest's bin entries, and symlinks them into a normalized bin directory with deduplicated names so the Nix build exposes package executables uniformly.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration scoped to the Playwright e2e test directory, extending the app package's base tsconfig with test-specific compiler options.

nodes.name: happydom.ts
nodes.summary: Test DOM shim that registers happy-dom globally and replaces HTMLCanvasElement.getContext with a stubbed CanvasRenderingContext2D so canvas-dependent UI code can run in Node-based unit tests.
nodes.languageNotes: Overrides the canvas prototype at test-setup time and falls through to the original implementation for non-2d contexts.

nodes.name: playwright.config.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright e2e configuration for the web app: a chromium project, the Vite dev server booted via `bun run dev` as a reusable webServer, and HTML/line reporters with retries and traces configured for CI.

nodes.name: _headers
nodes.summary: Cloudflare Pages header rules that force correct Content-Type headers for JavaScript, ES-module, and CSS assets served from the app's public directory.

nodes.name: oc-theme-preload.js
nodes.summary: Blocking theme bootstrap script that reads the persisted theme id and color scheme from localStorage, migrates legacy oc-1 themes to oc-2, sets data-theme/data-color-scheme on the document element, and injects cached theme CSS to prevent a flash of unstyled content.

nodes.name: serialize.ts
nodes.summary: Port of the xterm.js serialize addon for ghostty-web: walks terminal buffer cells, diffs SGR styles between cells, and reconstructs ANSI escape sequences that can restore terminal state, plus a plain-text serialization mode.
nodes.languageNotes: Class hierarchy mirrors xterm.js (BaseSerializeHandler to StringSerializeHandler) with per-cell SGR diffing to minimize emitted escape codes.

nodes.name: app.tsx
nodes.summary: SolidJS application root: composes the full provider stack (query client, i18n, dialogs, SDK, sync, theming, routing), lazy-loads route pages, and gates rendering on a server health check with a connection-error fallback screen.
nodes.languageNotes: ConnectionGate runs the health-check retry loop inside Effect.gen with timeoutOrElse/ensuring, bridging Effect fibers into Solid's createResource lifecycle.

nodes.name: parseEntry
nodes.summary: Parses a bun store directory label ("@scope+name@version") into name and version parts, treating "+" as the scope-path separator and rejecting malformed labels.

nodes.name: collectPackages
nodes.summary: Walks the bun modules store including @scoped subdirectories and returns the sorted list of package directory paths that expose a manifest.

nodes.name: linkBinary
nodes.summary: Creates a relative symlink for a package's bin entry inside the normalized bin root, skipping duplicates via a seen-set and removing stale links first.

nodes.name: isBuffer
nodes.summary: Duck-types a value as a terminal buffer by checking its type field, cursor coordinates, and getLine/getNullCell members.

nodes.name: getTerminalBuffers
nodes.summary: Extracts the normal and alternate buffers from a terminal-like object using structural checks so the addon works without importing ghostty-web internals.

nodes.name: equalFlags
nodes.summary: Compares the attribute flags (bold, italic, underline, blink, inverse, invisible, dim, strikethrough) of two buffer cells to decide whether SGR state changed.

nodes.name: BaseSerializeHandler
nodes.summary: Abstract buffer serializer that iterates rows and cells within a buffer range, delegating to overridable _nextCell/_rowEnd/_serializeString hooks.

nodes.name: StringSerializeHandler
nodes.summary: Concrete serializer that emits ANSI escape sequences with per-cell SGR diffing, cursor-style tracking, wide-character handling, and row separators so output can restore terminal state.

nodes.name: SerializeAddon
nodes.summary: Addon entry point that activates on a terminal and exposes serialize() (escape-sequence output over scrollback or an explicit range) and serializeAsText() for plain-text extraction.

nodes.name: QueryProvider
nodes.summary: Wraps children in a TanStack Query QueryClientProvider bound to a shared client for the subtree.

nodes.name: AppShellProviders
nodes.summary: Nests the app-level context providers (global SDK, sync, layout, permission, notification) around the application shell.

nodes.name: SessionProviders
nodes.summary: Installs per-session providers such as prompt, comments, and highlights around session-scoped routes.

nodes.name: RouterRoot
nodes.summary: Declares the root Solid router with a lazy-loaded home route and parameterized session routes.

nodes.name: AppBaseProviders
nodes.summary: Base provider composition (theme, i18n, dialogs, marked renderer, fonts) plus desktop titlebar wiring and Sentry error capturing; exported for reuse outside the default tree.

nodes.name: ConnectionGate
nodes.summary: Polls server health with an Effect retry loop (repeat until healthy, timeout with background-mode fallback), exposes retry and switch-server actions, and only renders children once a connection is established.

nodes.name: ConnectionError
nodes.summary: Full-screen connection failure view that names the unreachable server, offers other known servers to switch to, and auto-retries on an interval until cleanup.

nodes.name: AppInterface
nodes.summary: Top-level app interface composing the connection gate, layout shell, dialog stack, and debug bar; exported as the embeddable app surface.
